evidence_quotes:
USAGE: Transmission
(4L80-E)
FLUID/LUBRICANT: Dexron
® III only
(Do not use Dexron® II)
CAPACITIES: Dry: 13.5 qt (12.8L)
Drain & Refill 7.7 qt (7.3 L)
EXPECTED TEMPERATURE: All Temperatures
Except Arctic
statements.reason: The non-arctic 4L80-E entry specifies Dexron® III only and expressly excludes Dexron® II.
statements.statement: In non-arctic service, only Dexron® III is allowed in the 4L80-E transmission; Dexron® II may not be used.

evidence_quotes:
Use only Dexron®
III for 4L80-E transmission. Failure to
use only Dexron® III for 4L80E
transmission will cause damage to
transmission.
statements.reason: The warning says failure to use only Dexron® III will damage the 4L80-E transmission.
statements.statement: In non-arctic service, using Dexron® II in the 4L80-E transmission will damage it.

evidence_quotes:
• Use Dexron® II for filling transfer
case. Failure to use Dexron® II
will cause damage to transfer case.
statements.reason: The transfer-case instruction calls for Dexron® II without distinguishing between transmission types.
statements.statement: In non-arctic service, Dexron® II can be used to fill the transfer case regardless of transmission type.

statements.reason: The source gives that fill quantity, but does not establish it as a level criterion on level ground.
statements.statement: In non-arctic service, on level ground, the stated transfer-case level criterion for model 218 is a fill of 3.5 quarts (3.3 L).

statements.reason: The source gives that fill quantity, but does not establish it as a level criterion on level ground.
statements.statement: In non-arctic service, on level ground, the stated transfer-case level criterion for model 242 is a fill of 3.35 quarts (3.17 L).
